mechanism_gate: PASS. Every mechanism it invokes is independently attested inside Indo-Aryan.

hypothesis: A Dravidian language was spoken in or adjacent to the northwest during the period of Rigvedic composition and lent vocabulary into Old Indo-Aryan.
chronology_gate: CANNOT BE RUN AT VERIFIED LEVEL. No absolute date for Proto-Dravidian or its northwestern presence is establishable from anything retrieved (DE-M-027). Relative chronology only, on Arnold's strata, single-sourced (DEP-001).
geography_gate: PASS, and it is carried by exactly one language. Nearest attested Dravidian lect to the northwest is Brahui at 393 km; remove Brahui and it is Kolami at 1,055 km, farther than Munda's nearest member (DE-M-023, DE-M-025).
mechanism_gate: PASS. Lexical borrowing under contact is an ordinary, independently observed mechanism, and Turner records the loan direction explicitly in 224 entries (DE-M-002).
positive_evidence_gate: PRESENT BUT THIN AT THE RIGVEDIC END. 224 loan attributions in CDIAL, of which 15 have a Rigvedic simplex, 15 distinct lemmas, 21 tokens, 0.013% of the corpus (DE-M-009 to DE-M-011). Large attested and reconstructed base behind the donor: 76,303 DEDR reflex rows, 1,286 Proto-Dravidian starred forms (DE-M-013, DE-M-014).
diagnostic_predictions: Loans should concentrate in later strata rather than spread evenly; should show recipient-language adaptation; should cluster in identifiable semantic domains; and Brahui should behave as a relict rather than a recent arrival. The first is measured and holds (DE-M-012). The second and third are not tested here. The fourth is HYP-E-004.
reason: Passes on mechanism, geography and positive evidence. Does NOT pass on chronology at this record's standard, and the pass on geography is single-language. Both limits are carried into every downstream row rather than dropped once the gate is cleared.

hypothesis: A Munda language proper was spoken in the northwest during Rigvedic composition and lent vocabulary into Old Indo-Aryan.
chronology_gate: CANNOT BE RUN AT VERIFIED LEVEL, same reason as HYP-E-001. IH-119 (Munda arrival c. 2000 BCE) is INHERITED-UNVERIFIED and is not used.
geography_gate: ADVERSE. No attested Munda lect falls inside the northwestern envelope; the nearest is Korku at 855 km, and the Munda longitude envelope begins east of where the northwestern one ends (DE-M-022, DE-M-024). §4.P forbids reading modern distribution as prehistoric distribution, so this weakens the hypothesis without closing it.
mechanism_gate: PASS in principle - borrowing is borrowing - but the mechanism requires a Munda presence the geography does not evidence.
positive_evidence_gate: THIN AND NARROWLY SOURCED. 55 CDIAL loan attributions, of which 5 have a Rigvedic simplex (DE-M-003, DE-M-009); 85% of the 55 cite Kuiper or PMWS, so they approximate one authority (DE-M-028). Donor base is real but small in the retrieved data: 1,096 attested reflexes, 127 reconstructed Proto-Munda etyma (DE-M-015).
diagnostic_predictions: If Munda proper were the donor, loans should show Munda phonological shape and Munda-specific semantics, and some Munda presence west of Korku should be recoverable. Neither is testable from what was retrieved.

hypothesis: Brahui is a relict of an earlier and wider Dravidian distribution in the northwest.
chronology_gate: CANNOT GATE HERE. Requires Elfenbein and the Brahui literature, unretrieved; IH-236 already records that source as named but never read.
geography_gate: CONSISTENT WITH THE MEASUREMENT. Brahui sits 393 km from the nearest northwestern lect and 8.6 degrees of longitude west of the next Dravidian language (DE-M-023, DE-M-025). Isolation is what the measurement shows; it does not by itself say how the isolation arose.
mechanism_gate: PASS. Survival of a language island around which the surrounding population shifted is an ordinary, widely observed process.
positive_evidence_gate: The isolation itself, plus DEDR's inclusion of Brahui as a Dravidian language (DE-M-013).
diagnostic_predictions: Relict predicts archaic retentions shared with Dravidian generally rather than with any one modern branch, and no trace of a recent transit corridor.
